svg.text: What goes into agent context files
We write down how the code works. We rarely write down how to keep it safe.
written often: how the code works
fewer than one in six files say anything
we document the code. we forget the guardrails.
Share of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories containing each instruction type (five of 16 types studied).
Sources: Chatlatanagulchai et al., arXiv 2511.12884; overview finding, Gloaguen et al., arXiv 2602.11988.
